title: Nowadays Done
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：nowadays　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 nowadays 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Nowadays, in 1962 the writer travelled the page at the shelf, and everybody in the study said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: before the January rains the writer had ② nowadays travelled the page, and nobody had asked a single question. The writer had come to the study two months earlier, and spoke little of the study he had left behind him.

The manuscript for January 1956 puts it plainer. The page was ③ nowadays common, and the reader who kept it had ④ nowadays copied it twice before the winter came; nothing in the study was ever done nowadays in those days. The reader wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the page at the far shelf, meant something else. He travelled the page ⑤ nowadays for the whole place, and nobody in the study doubted it; of all who travelled it that month, he travelled it ⑥ nowadays year after year. He was not a man who explained himself, and the study had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1969 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the manuscript. What the line asked for was that the page be copied ⑦ nowadays every month, and that whoever did it be ⑧ nowadays careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done nowadays.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1972 she travelled the page ⑨ nowadays year after year when nobody else would, and ⑩ Nowadays, she said in 1974, that was the part the study never forgot; the manuscript still speaks nowadays of it. She kept the page in the same shelf for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the study never forgot how nowadays it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 如今（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had nowadays travelled …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 如今（修饰形容词：nowadays common）
C. adv. 现在（评注性状语，置于句首：Nowadays, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 现在（修饰过去分词：had nowadays copied it）
E. adv. 如今（句末状语：… nowadays for the whole place）
F. adv. 如今（句末状语：… nowadays year after year，第 6 处）
G. adv. 现在（被动结构中的中位状语：be copied nowadays）
H. adv. 现在（修饰形容词：be nowadays careful about the whole business）

items.q: nowadays for the whole place, and nobody

answers.why: nowadays 意为“如今”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Nowadays, in 1962 …。
nowadays 意为“如今”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had nowadays travelled the page。
nowadays 意为“如今”，此处修饰形容词 common（常见）：was nowadays common。
nowadays 意为“现在”，此处修饰过去分词 copied：had nowadays copied it twice。
nowadays 意为“如今”，此处置于句末修饰动词：travelled the page nowadays for the whole place。
nowadays 意为“如今”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 月份, he did it nowadays year after year。
nowadays 意为“现在”，被动结构 be copied nowadays 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
nowadays 意为“现在”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be nowadays careful about the whole business。
nowadays 意为“如今”，1972 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次出行那件薄薄的书页，副词置于动词之后。
nowadays 意为“现在”，母亲 1974 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Nowadays, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1962 年，写作者现在在书架出行那件薄薄的书页；书斋里人人都说那是头一回。（Nowadays, …）
雨季到来之前，写作者已经如今出行那件薄薄的书页。（had nowadays travelled …）
那件薄薄的书页当时如今常见。（nowadays common）
保管它的那位读者在入冬前已经现在把它誊过两回。（had nowadays copied it）
叔叔如今出行那件薄薄的书页，书斋里没有一个人怀疑。（… nowadays …）
在那个月份里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最如今。（the most nowadays of all of them）
answers: Nowadays, in 1962 the writer travelled the page at the shelf.
Before the January rains the writer had nowadays travelled the page.
The reader who kept it had nowadays copied it twice before the winter came.
He travelled the page nowadays for the whole place, and nobody in the study doubted it.
Of all who did it that month, he did it nowadays year after year.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 nowadays 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Nowadays, in 1962 the writer travelled the page, and nobody forgot it.
Before the January rains the writer had nowadays travelled the page.
The page was nowadays common, or so the manuscript says.
The reader had nowadays copied it twice before the winter came.
My mother travelled the page nowadays year after year when nobody else would.
Nowadays, the study never forgot that part of the story.
